text:
uname -a
id
mount
cat /etc/alpine-release
dmesg | tail -n 80

printf "\033[2J\033[HAlpine 3.24.2: serial login as root\n" > /dev/tty1
(uname -a; id -u; mount) | tee -a /dev/tty1

dd if=/media/cdrom/boot/modloop-virt of=/tmp/root-meta.xz bs=1 skip=22926980 count=1912
sha256sum /tmp/root-meta.xz
busybox xz -dc /tmp/root-meta.xz > /tmp/root-meta.raw
echo XZ_STATUS=$?
sha256sum /tmp/root-meta.raw

busybox --list | grep -E 'xz|lzma'
ls /media/cdrom/apks/x86_64/*xz* /media/cdrom/apks/x86_64/*lzma*
busybox unxz -c /tmp/root-meta.xz > /tmp/root-meta.raw
echo UNXZ_STATUS=$?
sha256sum /tmp/root-meta.raw

printf "\033[2J\033[HAlpine 3.24.2: serial login as root\n" > /dev/tty1
(uname -a; id | cut -d " " -f 1-2; mount) | tee -a /dev/tty1
